There are front and side views of RT3000AM. The RT3000AM is 1,730mm in height, 700mm in width, and 775mm in depth. When viewed from the top of the RT3000AM, the detail size is 661mm excluding the door and 775mm including the door. The door is opened up to 120°(Fridge), 140°(Freezer) with a width of 1,213mm and a front width of 700mm when the door is opened to 90°. When the door of RT3000AM is opened at 90°, the length from the back of the product to the front of the door shall be 1,371mm, and the product shall be installed with a space of more than 50mm from the wall.
